title: In vitro and in silico hybrid approach to unveil triterpenoids from Helicteres hirsuta leaves as potential compounds for inhibiting Nrf2
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1915-1923
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07646J, Paper
Open Access

Minh Hien Nguyen, Nguyen Thien Han Le, Bui Quoc Huy Nguyen, Mai Thanh Thi Nguyen, Truong Nhat Van Do, Tho Huu Le, Vu Thanh Nguyen, Chia-Hung Yen
3β-O-trans-caffeoylbetulinic acid from Helicteres hirsuta inhibited Nrf2 in Huh7 with IC50 of 74.5 μg mL−1. Docking and dynamics simulations showed strong binding affinity of this compound and PI3Kα, an upstream modulator of Nrf2 in cancer cells.
